issue: Services exist only as #anchors on one page
recommended_fix: Create /training/, /consulting/ and /speaking/ pages with unique copy and keywords, following the /solomon-engine/ model; point nav and cards at them.

issue: Primary hero CTA leaves the site for ElevenLabs
recommended_fix: Embed the ElevenLabs/Columbus agent on-site as an inline widget or branded modal; never let the primary CTA exit the domain.

issue: Columbus 3-minute assessment CTA opens a contact form
evidence: `a 'Let's Go!'` "Take our 3-minute assessment guided by AI assistant Columbus -> #contact"
recommended_fix: Wire 'Let's Go!' to the real Columbus assessment; if it does not exist yet, remove the copy.

issue: 'Book A Call Today' has no booking mechanism
evidence: `section 'Book A Call Today'` "only a logo and tagline text"
recommended_fix: Embed a Cal.com or Calendly inline scheduler in the section.

issue: Seven headline statistics have no source
evidence: `stat callouts` "92% adoption rates"; `stat callouts` "40% reduction in course development time"
recommended_fix: Footnote each stat with its source or 'based on N client cohorts, 2024-25'; drop any that cannot be sourced.

issue: 'Guiding Principles' and Consulting 'Learn More' CTAs misdirect
evidence: `a 'Learn About Our Guiding Principles'` "-> #contact"; `a 'Learn More' (Consulting)` "-> elevenlabs.io"
recommended_fix: Point each CTA at the content its label names (principles section, /consulting/ page).

issue: Hero (and H1) duplicated in the DOM
evidence: `h1 x2` "Stop Implementing AI Tools. Start Architecting Human Performance."
recommended_fix: Replace the mobile/desktop clones with one responsive hero and a single H1.

issue: No case studies with measurable outcomes
evidence: `testimonials only` "No case studies with before/after detail"
recommended_fix: Publish 2-3 case studies using the case-study template (challenge, intervention, metric).
Add brand-name alt text and a caption or hover label to each logo; use monochrome PNGs.

issue: WCAG basics fail: stock/filename alt, no skip link
evidence: `img alt` "Young asia student study in the public library, She makes note on notebook."
recommended_fix: Rewrite alt text, add a skip link, check secondary-text contrast in services.

evidence: `JSON-LD` "No schema markup evident for FAQPage, Person, Service"
recommended_fix: Add FAQPage JSON-LD on the FAQ, Person on the founder bio and Service on each service URL.

issue: Stock-library alt text on service images
evidence: `services img alt` "Young asia student study in the public library..."
recommended_fix: Replace with descriptive, keyworded alt text per image.

issue: No engagement model or price signal
evidence: `services section` "Consulting, Training, Speaking: no pricing or engagement model"
recommended_fix: Add an engagement-model line per service (format, duration, 'from' price or 'typical engagement').

issue: Internal links are anchors, not pages
recommended_fix: Link services, blog posts and future case studies to each other with descriptive anchor text.
Add a newsletter sign-up and a YouTube channel for demos; list a direct email.

evidence: `buttons` "some bordered, some filled, some plain text links"
recommended_fix: Define primary (Mustard Gold fill), secondary (outline) and text-link styles and apply site-wide.

issue: No CTA after the named testimonials
evidence: `testimonials section` "Korn Ferry, Purdue Global; next element is not a CTA"
recommended_fix: Add the primary 'Book a consultation' button directly after the testimonials.
